Where to stay in Barcelona

Every area rated for day and night, with the reasoning and the sources behind each rating. The map is below the table.

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 73 areas reviewed individually Methodology →

For a short stay in Barcelona, the areas this map rates best are la Dreta de l'Eixample, la Salut and el Poble-sec. Each is picked from the ratings and the sights below, not chosen by hand — the reasoning is on the card.
